summary: Neo, Trinity, and two others move quickly down a back street. Neo asks if Morpheus is alive. Trinity relays the question to Tank, who confirms via voice-over that Morpheus is alive and being moved. Trinity then informs Neo he is alive. Tank adds that Cypher is nearby, having been sent to Franklin and Erie, prompting Trinity to acknowledge the information.

what_changes.evidence: TRINITY He's alive. Again, inevitability seems to cinch around Neo.

what_changes.after: Knows Cypher is at Franklin and Erie
what_changes.evidence: TANK (V.O.) So did we. I sent him to Franklin and Erie. TRINITY Got it.

event_hint.one_line: The group moves quickly while receiving status updates on Morpheus and Cypher.
